description: Messages from a school to parents.

key.instructions: The parent needs to reply or do something

not_key.instructions: No reply or action is needed from the parent

s2.instructions: The child is currently unwell or hurt

s3.instructions: The message concerns the child's health or safety

cases.state: Arjun has been sick twice this morning and is lying down in the nurse's office. Please pick him up as soon as you can.
Arjun felt sick early this morning but has been fine since 10am and is enjoying art class. No need to pick him up; we'll keep an eye on him.
The Year 4 trip to the science museum is on Friday. Please sign and return the permission slip by Wednesday, or your child cannot attend.
The Year 4 trip to the science museum last Friday was a great success. Photos are now on the class page.
Our head lice check found lice on several children in Class 2B, including yours. Please treat your child's hair before they return tomorrow.
Our routine head lice check found no lice in Class 2B, including on your child. Thank you for your help.
Sofia's two library books are overdue. Please return them by Friday or pay the replacement fee.
Thanks for returning Sofia's two library books. Her library account is now clear.
